apiKeys.sectionHint: All keys stored in device SecureStore. The app works without every API registered.
apiKeys.saveRejectedMessage: Invalid input — kept existing key (reason: {{reason}}). Blank, masked, or under 10 chars are not saved.
apiKeys.deleteAllIntro:
Deletes all API keys stored on device (OpenAI, Twelve Data, News, X, Reddit, etc.).
App data (holdings, history) is kept.
apiKeys.deleteAllContinueMessage: Delete all API keys. Are you sure?
apiKeys.openAiRequiredBody: Reading transaction screenshots requires an OpenAI API key. Use manual or natural-language entry instead.

reset.title: Reset all
reset.hint: Deletes virtual capital, holdings, trade history, manual orders, alerts, learning history, app settings, and cache. API keys are kept.
reset.confirmMessage:
Reset everything?
API keys are kept (use "Delete all API keys" separately).
This cannot be undone.
